posts.text: ADHD hack: gamify everything. Beat the clock, not yourself. This hit hard.
Small wins are still wins—especially for ADHD brains.
ADHD hits different when your culture equates productivity with worth.
ADHD logic: I’ll remember it later. (Narrator: they did not remember it later.)

You don't look ADHD is not a diagnosis, it's just someone's outdated mental picture. Doctors are finally saying out loud what a lot of us already knew, adult ADHD gets missed constantly because it doesn't look like a hyper eight year old boy. It looks like the woman exhausted from holding it together, the guy called lazy instead of overwhelmed, the person with a system for everything who still misses the thing.
Say the thing you’re scared is too real
